name: Embassy Otherworld
source:
In Embassy Otherworld, you work at the Embassy, set in a world between worlds, where hundreds of doors lead to hundreds of worlds. Normally you're just a cubicle drone, but thanks to a useless coworker you end up on field assignment.

Now it's your job to find out what lies beyond a brand new door, your discoveries will determine whether this door is sealed forever or whether it will lead to a brand new Embassy location.

More importantly, who is the strange masked figure in the woods?

[From [url=https://carziecat.itch.io/embassy-otherworld-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《大使馆异界》中，你在大使馆工作，大使馆位于世界之间的世界，数百扇门通向数百个世界。通常情况下，你只是一个小隔间里的无人机，但多亏了一个无用的同事，你最终被派往现场。

现在你的任务是找出一扇全新的门后面有什么，你的发现将决定这扇门是否被永远密封，或者是否会通往一个全新的大使馆地点。

更重要的是，树林里那个奇怪的蒙面人是谁？

[来自[url=https://carziecat.itch.io/embassy-otherworld-demo]itch.io[/url]]
